archetypes.name: dispatch-coverage
archetypes.rationale: Plan-file coverage warnings must stay advisory without false positives.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 2 dispatcher coverage gate. Focus on the distinction between explicit plan scope, fallback scope, git probe failure, and plan-read failure. Verify warning KVs are emitted only when intended and that commit behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
